title: Sage mesh_lod record
description: A mesh_lod record (MeshLodRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another mesh_lod record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

metric.description: What the switch points measure: Distance (metres) or ScreenSize (share of the view's height) (LodMetric, default "Distance")

levels.description: The coarser levels, finest first; level 0 is the renderer's own mesh. (List<MeshLodLevel>)

mesh.description: The coarser mesh drawn from this level's switch on. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

material.description: Its material; empty = the renderer's own. Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

distance.description: Metric Distance: drawn from this far from the camera on. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

screenSize.description: Metric ScreenSize: drawn once the mesh covers less than this share of the view's height. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

levels+.description: Adds to "levels": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

mesh.description: The coarser mesh drawn from this level's switch on. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

material.description: Its material; empty = the renderer's own. Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

distance.description: Metric Distance: drawn from this far from the camera on. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

screenSize.description: Metric ScreenSize: drawn once the mesh covers less than this share of the view's height. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

levels-.description: Removes these from "levels" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

mesh.description: The coarser mesh drawn from this level's switch on. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

material.description: Its material; empty = the renderer's own. Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

distance.description: Metric Distance: drawn from this far from the camera on. Unit: m. At least 0. (float)

screenSize.description: Metric ScreenSize: drawn once the mesh covers less than this share of the view's height. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

cullDistance.description: Metric Distance: not drawn at all past this; 0 = always drawn. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 0)

cullScreenSize.description: Metric ScreenSize: not drawn at all below this share of the view's height; 0 = always drawn. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0)

hysteresis.description: How far inside a switch point the camera must come back before the finer level returns (a fraction) Range: 0 to 0.9. (float, default 0.1)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
